vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Okay — what's the first step?"
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — Wolfgang telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 30s about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 75/100)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Wolfgang telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — Eamon telling A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms about A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You've started noticing: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek and Dmitri never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)

🌿 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (9 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Wolfgang telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Jovan about himself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)

🔥 The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jovan mutters "Say that again — slower." the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Eamon about Leah. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.

🌿 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (13 stone now.)
👥 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek walks out with Leah. "Nobody walks alone today."
🚶 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is back with Leah.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Eamon, Leah, Kassa and Diana met them at the door — 4 put down. Eamon, Leah, Kassa, Diana are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Eamon, Wolfgang, Diana and Dmitri met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Eamon, Wolfgang, Diana, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leah just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kassa just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
